_about: 0050 أ: «أذكار المواقف». Each item is a hadith of HadeethEnc (sahih or hasan, marfu'), its `segments` the words to say cut from its own Arabic text, verbatim (worker/test/mawaqif-0050.test.ts). `kind` «say»: the words to say; «action»: the hadith describes what to do without its words, and the box shows the hadith's own wording of it. `intro` is our interface line in the ten languages (Arabic and English reviewed; the others machine translations). `proposed`: found in the search, not on the board. Shown to no one until the coordinator writes «reviewed».
